subject.title: feat(ios): improve onboarding gateway connection flow

question: Should this PR's connection-chooser first screen replace the current QR-first iOS onboarding flow, or should the branch be narrowed to the secure Tailscale/auth-recovery pieces on top of current main?
rationale: Current main already merged a different onboarding refresh, this branch conflicts with it, and choosing between the first-run flows is a UX/product decision that source review cannot safely infer.

options.title: Narrow onto current onboarding
options.body: Rebase on current main and keep only the Tailscale/remote security and auth-copy improvements that fit the existing QR-first flow.

options.title: Sponsor the chooser redesign
options.body: Accept the larger first-screen chooser direction and require the contributor to resolve conflicts, typography, and current-main parity before merge.

options.title: Pause or close this branch
options.body: If the useful pieces are smaller than the conflicted UI rewrite, ask for a fresh narrow PR instead of continuing this branch.

recommendation.title: Narrow onto current onboarding
recommendation.body: Rebase on current main and keep only the Tailscale/remote security and auth-copy improvements that fit the existing QR-first flow.

likelyOwner.reason: The most recent current-main history touches both central iOS files, making this the best available routing candidate despite noisy broad-commit provenance.
